items.title: Rumor: Travis Scott x Nike GTA 6 Sneakers Listed for Launch Day in Three Colorways
items.summary: Wanted-star sneakers on a release calendar. Your wallet just got a wanted level.
items.body: Travis Scott sneakers tied to GTA 6 have reportedly appeared on a store's release calendar for the same day as the game, in three colorways with wanted-star details. No one has officially confirmed a Nike, Cactus Jack and Rockstar collaboration, so this is an unconfirmed listing.
items.x_post_text: Rumor: Travis Scott x Nike #GTA6 sneakers with wanted stars are listed on a store calendar for launch day in three colorways. Not confirmed by anyone officially. #GTAVI #Nike

items.title: Sony Ships PS5 Update 26.07 Ahead of GTA 6 - and a Rumor Says the Game Needs It
items.summary: Sony patches the PS5 just in time for GTA 6. Coincidence is a strong word.
items.body:
Sony released PS5 system update 26.07 (14.22.00.00) with security fixes, though it has not said exactly what it fixes. A researcher reported running his own code on the previous firmware within hours of that firmware's release.

Separately, the PlayStation Game Size account on X claims GTA 6 may require system software 14.22.00.00 or later. That claim is a rumor: Rockstar and Sony have not confirmed a firmware requirement. Updating your console before pre-load is a sensible move either way.
items.x_post_text: Sony shipped PS5 update 26.07 (14.22.00.00) with security fixes, and a tracker claims #GTA6 may need that firmware or newer. Unconfirmed by Rockstar or Sony. Update before pre-load anyway. #GTAVI #PS5

items.title: A PS5 Pro Label for GTA 6 Appeared on PlayStation's French Site - But It May Be Fake
items.summary: A PS5 Pro badge appears and disappears. Believe it when Rockstar says so.
items.body: A PS5 Pro support label for GTA 6, mentioning PSSR and enhanced ray tracing, reportedly appeared on PlayStation's French website. Neither Rockstar nor Sony has confirmed it, and users suspect the listing is fake. Treat it as an unverified sighting until an official PS5 Pro statement arrives.
items.x_post_text: A PS5 Pro label for #GTA6 mentioning PSSR and enhanced ray tracing reportedly appeared on PlayStation's French site. Neither Rockstar nor Sony confirmed it, and users suspect it's fake. #GTAVI #PS5Pro

items.title: UK Police Make a GTA-Style Wanted-Level Video About a Driver Who Will Miss GTA 6 in Prison

items.body: Derbyshire Police edited a chase video in the style of GTA, complete with a wanted level and HUD. The driver was jailed for dangerous and drug driving, which means he will miss GTA 6's launch. Viewers spotted one mistake in the video.
items.x_post_text: Derbyshire Police made a GTA-style chase video with a wanted level and HUD about a driver jailed for dangerous and drug driving. He'll miss #GTA6 launch. Real life has no respawn. #GTAVI

items.title: Rockstar Moves GTA 6 Pre-Load Up to November 10 - 212 GB Needed on PS5, Midnight Local Launch Everywhere
items.summary: Preload moves up to November 10. 212 GB of free space: yes, that includes deleting your backlog. No, you can't play early.
items.body:
Rockstar announced on November 3 that pre-loading for GTA 6 begins on November 10, earlier than the November 12 date that was previously reported. The Newswire post says the game is only a few weeks away and that there is still time to pre-order.

On PS5, pre-loading starts Tuesday, November 10 at midnight local time and is for digital pre-orders, according to the PlayStation Blog announcement as summarized by Vice. PS5 owners need 212 GB of free space. VGTimes reports that pre-loading on Xbox Series X|S also begins globally on November 10, though the Xbox size was not confirmed in the material I reviewed.

Pre-loading does not give early access. The game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19 in each region, so players in New Zealand get in first. Vice's conversion table for that moment: 3:00 AM Pacific, 6:00 AM Eastern, 11:00 AM UK and 12:00 PM Central Europe on November 18, 8:00 PM in Japan and 10:00 PM in Sydney on November 18. Nothing was reported about a Day One patch.

Practical advice: clear space now, since 212 GB is a lot to find on a nearly full SSD, and start downloading on November 10 rather than at midnight on launch night.
items.x_post_text: Rockstar moved #GTA6 pre-load up to November 10. PS5 needs 212 GB free, and no, you can't play early: the game unlocks at midnight local time on Nov 19. Start deleting that backlog. #GTAVI #PS5

items.title: Sensor Tower Estimates GTA 6 Pre-Orders at 7.7 Million Copies and Over $750 Million
items.summary: Seven point seven million pre-orders and counting. Somewhere a fintech bro is calling it the "next asset class."
items.body:
Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 has about 7.71 million pre-orders and more than $750 million in pre-order revenue. The platform split is about 5.74 million on PS5, roughly $559 million or 74% of the total, and about 1.97 million on Xbox Series X/S, roughly $192 million.

Since October 19, estimated pre-order revenue rose by about $100 million, from $630 million, and pre-orders grew by about 1.3 million. If that trend continues, the report says revenue could reach $1 billion before launch. The only benchmark in the article is a Newzoo projection that GTA 6 could earn up to $5.2 billion in its first week on sale.

Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed any of these figures. They are analyst estimates with no published methodology, and the $1 billion number is a projection, not a result.
items.x_post_text: Sensor Tower estimates #GTA6 has 7.71M pre-orders and $750M+ in revenue, with 74% on PS5. Unconfirmed by Rockstar or Take-Two, but the trend points at $1B before launch. #GTAVI #PS5

items.title: Rockstar's Support Rules Say GTA 6 Spoiler Videos Could Be Removed Even After Launch
items.summary: Rockstar will pull spoiler videos, even after launch. Your "Full Story in 12 Minutes" upload is on thin ice.
items.body:
According to Rockstar's official support site guidelines, as summarized by VGTimes, the company may remove videos that show the ending, standalone cutscenes or other plot-revealing content. That means spoiler-heavy uploads can get taken down even after GTA 6 is out on November 19.

If you make gameplay videos, check Rockstar's content guidelines before launch. Streams and normal gameplay are one thing; uploading cutscenes or the ending is where takedown risk starts.
items.x_post_text: Rockstar's support guidelines say it may remove #GTA6 videos showing the ending, standalone cutscenes or other plot spoilers, even after launch. Creators, read the rules before you upload. #GTAVI

items.title: Take-Two CEO Brushes Off GTA 6 Dependence Fears at WSJ Tech
items.summary: The CEO says Take-Two is not a one-game company. The stock chart is checking its pockets.
items.body:
At WSJ Tech in Napa Valley on November 4, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick dismissed concerns that the company leans too heavily on GTA 6, pointing to its broader portfolio of franchises. The interviewer noted that Take-Two shares were more than 20% below their record high.

It is a CEO answering an investor-style question, not a financial forecast. Take-Two has not published new GTA 6 sales numbers.
items.x_post_text: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick says at WSJ Tech that the company isn't too dependent on #GTA6, pointing to its wider portfolio. Shares are reportedly 20%+ below their record high. #GTAVI #TakeTwo

items.title: GTA 6 Ads Pop Up in Barcelona, Edinburgh, Melbourne, Tokyo and Sao Paulo
items.summary: Five cities, one pre-order bonus. Vice City is going on world tour.
items.body:
Outdoor ads for GTA 6 have appeared in Barcelona, Edinburgh, Melbourne, Tokyo and Sao Paulo, according to VGTimes. The campaign promotes the Vintage Vice City Pack, described as the last pre-order bonus before the November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

The push follows Rockstar's real-world marketing in Miami and the Launch Trailer earlier in October.
items.x_post_text: #GTA6 ads are showing up in Barcelona, Edinburgh, Melbourne, Tokyo and Sao Paulo, pushing the Vintage Vice City Pack as the last pre-order bonus before the Nov 19 launch. #GTAVI

items.title: British Millionaire Says GTA 6 Could Save Players $5,000 by Replacing Nights Out
items.summary: A millionaire says stay in and play GTA 6. Cheapest piece of financial advice this year.
items.body:
Social media creator and British millionaire Mark Tilbury argues in a viral video posted October 31 that GTA 6 could pay for itself if players stay home instead of going out. He estimates what each hour in Vice City costs using a display copy of the game he picked up in a store, and compares it with what a typical night out costs.

It's a light-hearted take rather than financial advice. Still, with the Standard Edition reportedly priced at $79.99, the math isn't crazy if the game keeps you busy for weeks.
items.x_post_text: A British millionaire says #GTA6 could save players $5,000 by replacing nights out. Hours in Vice City vs a Friday at the bar. The math is hard to argue with. #GTAVI

items.title: Edge Magazine Gets 12 New GTA 6 Screenshots and a 16-Page Cover Story From Rockstar North
items.summary: Rockstar shows off swamps, sharks and a very suspicious cop. And no, it won't say whether Jason and Lucia get married.
items.source_name: Edge (via Khel Now, Game Rant, Notebookcheck)
items.body:
Rockstar gave Edge magazine a batch of 12 new GTA 6 screenshots on October 29, along with a 16-page cover feature built on a visit to Rockstar North in Edinburgh. The images show a much wider Leonida than the trailers did.

What the screenshots show, according to coverage of the issue: Vice City's waterfront, skyline and neon-lit streets; a rural Leonida town with low buildings and a motorcycle gang riding through; trailer parks and industrial edges on the outskirts; the Grassrivers swamp, where two armed men ride an airboat with alligators around; an underwater passage with a hammerhead shark over coral; and several shots of Jason and Lucia in new outfits, plus a police officer that fans are already theorizing about.

Rockstar's Rob Nelson told Edge the game is "ready," as reported by Game Rant. That supports the November 19 date, though it isn't a quality guarantee. Rockstar also declined to say whether Jason and Lucia can get married.

The coverage describes a Leonida nearly as large as the playable areas of GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined. The original Edge issue is a print magazine, so everything here is secondhand reporting until the issue itself circulates.
items.x_post_text: Edge got 12 new #GTA6 screenshots and a 16-page cover story from Rockstar North: swamps with alligators, a hammerhead shark, bikers in rural Leonida, and a suspicious cop. Rob Nelson says the game is "ready." #GTAVI #Edge

items.title: What Edge Says Is New in GTA 6: Smarter NPCs, K-9 Cops, Scooter Bros Delivery and a WAINK App
items.summary: K-9 cops, delivery scooters and a coffee that makes you faster. Rockstar thought of everything except your wanted level.
items.body:
According to coverage of Edge's 16-page special, GTA 6's systems go deeper than the trailers suggest. This list comes from Khel Now's summary of the issue, so treat the specifics as secondhand.

World: buses and trains are fully functional, days and nights last longer to feel closer to real time, and separate teams built the ads, TV shows, radio stations, political campaigns, pedestrians and fictional brands.

NPCs and police: pedestrians react based on location, personality and what they witness, so carrying a shotgun down the street alarms them more than slinging a weapon over your shoulder. Police can deploy K-9 units, track suspects by clothing and known accomplices, and handle pursuits more realistically. Robbery victims may resist, shoppers may step in, and armed drivers can fight back against carjackers.

Vehicles and items: a Scooter Bros service delivers your personal vehicle to your location, cars can carry tracking devices and have improved fuel management, and the in-game WAINK app helps locate valuable vehicles that criminal buyers want. Coffee boosts stamina and protein shakes temporarily increase health. The summary also mentions a Criminal Profile system, more enterable interiors and deeper Jason and Lucia relationship mechanics.

Rockstar has not published its own breakdown, and the summary contains no direct developer quotes.
items.x_post_text: New #GTA6 details from Edge coverage: smarter NPC reactions, police K-9 units, cops tracking you by clothing, Scooter Bros vehicle delivery and a WAINK app for valuable cars. Coffee even boosts stamina. #GTAVI
